### Summary of Changes 📝

Describe your changes in a concise and clear way. What does this PR do?

### Context and Motivation 🎯

Why is this change necessary? What problem does it solve? If this PR addresses an existing issue,
please link it here:

* **Closes #<ISSUE_NUMBER>** (e.g., `Closes #42`)
* **Fixes #<ISSUE_NUMBER>** (for bug reports)
* **Implements #<ISSUE_NUMBER>** (for feature requests)

### Type of Change (Check all that apply)

* [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
* [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
* [ ] Clinical Content Update (change to formulas, reference ranges, or accompanying documentation)
* [ ] Documentation update
* [ ] Refactoring/Code Cleanup (changes that don't affect user-facing functionality)

### Checklist for Reviewer 🧑‍💻

Please ensure these steps have been completed before requesting a review.

#### Code Quality Checks

* [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
* [ ] My changes follow the project's code style.
* [ ] I have run `flutter format .` locally.
* [ ] I have run `flutter analyze` and fixed all linting issues.
* [ ] I have added/updated unit tests for any new logic (where applicable).
* [ ] All existing tests pass locally (`flutter test`).

#### Functional Checks

* [ ] I have tested my changes on an emulator or physical device.
* [ ] I have tested on both iOS and Android (if applicable).

#### 🩺 Clinical Review Needed (If applicable)

If this PR involves changes to clinical formulas, reference data, or interpretation, please check
the box below:

* [ ] This PR requires a clinical review by a subject matter expert.

If you are offering a fix of clinical information, if relevant please post the reference or a worked
example if possible.
